name: Basement of the Dead Haunted House
tagline: Basement of the Dead Haunted House
description: Basement of the Dead Haunted House is an agritourism farm in 42 W New York St, IL, open to visitors for seasonal picking and farm activities. Offerings follow the growing season, so what is available changes through the year. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
